newsitem.title: HUNGARY: MOL, TVK CONFIRM 4YR DELIVERY DEAL.
newsitem.headline: MOL, TVK CONFIRM 4YR DELIVERY DEAL.

text.p: Hungarian oil and gas company MOL and chemicals company TVK on Friday confirmed news in the Budapest Stock Exchange's official gazette that they signed a four year delivery deal.

"MOL Rt will deliver about one million tonnes of chemical benzene and gas oil to TVK Rt per year, and rebuys the motor fuel components and benzol product (made of these materials) for further processing," MOL and TVK said in a joint statement.
The deliveries begin in 1997 and finish in 2000.
The companies said the contract would make sales calculable for MOL, while the pace of the deliveries would ensure the optimal storage of materials for TVK.
They added the price of the deliveries would be based on international price quotings and follow changes in world market prices.
Hungarian news agency MTI reported on Thursday that the new agreement replaces a previous one, concluded in 1993, when both companies were state-owned.
